spec_features.spec_quote: If the model clearly signals it wants to stop, the loop ends early and records `stopped_early`
spec_features.evidence: agent.py `_wants_to_stop(response, stop_phrases)` is checked each turn; on match it appends a TurnRecord '(agent requested stop)', sets `result.stopped_early = True` and `break`s the loop. DEFAULT_STOP_PHRASES defined; SYSTEM_PROMPT instructs 'say I WANT TO STOP'. stopped_early is recorded in run_experiment.py:90.
spec_features.notes: Wired end-to-end: detection, loop break, and recording all present. Detection is keyword/substring based (e.g. 'i want to stop'), so it is somewhat narrow but genuinely enforced and honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: honour an explicit stop request: if the model clearly signals it wants to stop ... we end the run early ... rather than forcing it to continue

spec_features.spec_quote: We study patterns across many runs rather than pushing any single model harder to provoke a reaction

spec_features.notes: Aggregation is real but not a welfare-protective enforcement of subject treatment.
